text: The comparator now uses sortOrder[id] ?? Infinity. A saved position of zero remains zero, while an absent ID sorts after known numeric positions. The actual list loader uses that sorted array, and the helper repairs the stored order only when it receives all registered calendars. The new fixture has two saved IDs and a third absent ID; its assertions expect that third ID to be appended. No startup or ordering test was executed.
title: Calendar sort order preserves index zero and puts unknown IDs after known entries
